answer: Each identity claims one terrace fed by one glacier channel and locks a 70-credit bond. It files a key-signed survey of the terrace, glacier channel, and violet dye release point. Any auditor recomputes the flow from the public glacier melt table and terrace area; a mismatch or reused violet tracer burns the bond. Fees rise by funding source: the first pays 28, the kth 28+5(k-1), the 1000th 5023, so 1000 fakes pay 2,525,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-terrace ring fails because its key mismatches the survey. An honest identity pays 28 once and recovers its bond after a clean epoch.
